metadata.subject: Algorithms
metadata.title: Selection Sort
metadata.description: Find the smallest remaining value and place it in its final position.

learning_objectives: Explain how Selection Sort chooses the smallest remaining value.
Follow one pass that places a value in its final position.
Sort an unfamiliar array through repeated selections.

mission.title: Find the smallest
mission.description: Watch Selection Sort place one smallest remaining value at a time.

introduction.title: Sort by choosing the next smallest value
introduction.content: Selection Sort looks through the unsorted values, chooses the smallest one, and places it at the next open position.
points: The left side gradually becomes sorted.
Each pass chooses one smallest remaining value.
You are about to watch one value earn its final position at a time.

worked_example.title: One selection pass
worked_example.content: Start at the left and search the remaining values for the smallest one.

steps.explanation: 20 is smaller than 50 and 40, so it is the smallest remaining value.
Move 20 to the first open position. Its position is now final.
Only the unsorted part still needs attention.

worked_example.conclusion: Selection Sort keeps choosing the smallest value that has not been placed yet.

next.title: Now you try.
next.content: Advance one pass at a time and watch the sorted side grow.

next-step: You found the smallest value in the whole array and placed it first.
Now search only the values that are still unsorted.
Another smallest remaining value has reached its final position.
Every value now has a final sorted position.

prediction.pending_message: Choose a prediction before you run the first pass.
prediction.required_message: Which value should Selection Sort place first? Make a prediction before seeing the pass.
prediction.heading: Before the first pass…
prediction.question: Which value will be placed at the first position?
prediction.selection_message: Your prediction: {prediction}. Now run the first pass to check it.

result.actual: The smallest value was {actual}, so it moved into the first position.

challenge.title: Selection Sort challenge
challenge.start_message: The array is mixed again. Compare the unsorted values and decide when the array is fully sorted.
challenge.continue_message: You can keep using Selection Sort in free play.

phases.title: Sort the whole array
phases.instruction: Build the target order by repeatedly selecting the smallest remaining value.
phases.success: ✓ Challenge complete — every value is in ascending order.
phases.feedback: Look at the unsorted part and keep placing its smallest value next.

mastery.title: Selection Sort Mastery
mastery.default_operation_rule: Each selection pass places one smallest remaining value.

guidance.start_message: Find the smallest value during each pass; the left side will become final first.

items.content: On each pass, compare only values that are not already in the sorted left side.

phases.title: Sort the practice array
phases.instruction: Use complete selection passes until every value is sorted.
phases.feedback: Keep selecting the smallest value from the unsorted part.

guidance.start_message: There are no hints this time. Decide which value each pass will place next.

phases.title: Apply Selection Sort
phases.instruction: Sort this fresh array without guidance.
phases.feedback: The next selected value must be the smallest one still unsorted.

guidance.start_message: Sort the array within the pass limit. Plan where the smallest values belong.

constraints.operation_limit_message: Pass limit reached. The array is not sorted yet; retry with a complete plan.

phases.title: Solve in three passes
phases.instruction: Transform START into TARGET using no more than 3 selection passes.
phases.feedback: A correct Selection Sort pass always fixes the next smallest remaining value.

levels.label: Mastery

guidance.start_message: Use the pattern, not hints: choose the smallest remaining value until the array is sorted.

levels.operation_rule: Each pass places one value permanently.

constraints.operation_limit_message: All four passes are used. Retry and keep the selection pattern consistent.

phases.title: Master the pattern
phases.instruction: Sort an unfamiliar array with one deliberate selection pass per final position.
phases.feedback: Keep the sorted part on the left and select from everything to its right.

thinking.title: Predict the passes
thinking.instruction: Do not run the passes yet. Mentally choose the smallest remaining value on each pass.
thinking.do_not_execute: Do not perform these passes in the playground. Work through them mentally from top to bottom.

prediction_fields.label: Final sorted array
prediction_fields.prompt: After all passes, what will the array contain?

feedback.incorrect: Compare each pass: Selection Sort chooses the smallest remaining value before placing it.

thinking.replay_message: Now watch the selection passes replay.

solve.title: Expert Selection Sort
solve.instruction: Sort the unfamiliar array with no hints. Aim for one correct selection pass per final position.
solve.solved_result: Your solution: {{operations}} passes. Optimal solution: {{optimal_operations}} passes.
solve.perfect_result: You reached the target in the optimal {{optimal_operations}} passes.

quiz.question: What does Selection Sort place during each pass?
options: The smallest value remaining in the unsorted part
The largest value anywhere in the array

discovery.title: Selection Sort discovery
discovery.summary: Selection Sort grows a sorted left side by selecting the smallest value that is still unplaced.

sections.title: What?
sections.content: Selection Sort repeatedly chooses the smallest value from the unsorted part of an array.

sections.title: Example
sections.content: In [50, 20, 40], choose 20 first and place it at the beginning: [20, 50, 40].

sections.title: Why?
sections.content: Once the smallest remaining value is placed, no later value can belong before it.

sections.title: Remember
sections.content: Find the smallest remaining value → place it next. Time complexity: O(n²).

alternate_explanations.title: Think of arranging cards
alternate_explanations.content: Look through the cards you have not arranged, pick the lowest number, and move it into the next open spot on the left.

alternate_explanations.title: Walk through it
alternate_explanations.content: For [30, 10, 20], select 10 first to get [10, 30, 20], then select 20 to finish [10, 20, 30].

recall.title: Recall
recall.prompt: In your own words, why is the left side of a Selection Sort array already sorted?
recall.model_answer: Each pass puts the smallest value still remaining into the next position on the left, so no later value should come before it.
